title: Drive virtualized history-rest timer deterministically in viewport-fill regression
outcome: The four viewport-fill parameter cases prove no history demand during movement and the correct demand after rest without racing host time or waiting a fixed260ms.
acceptance: ui/src/panels/AgentSessionPanel.virtualization.test.tsx test 'fills %s history shown %s in the viewport once it rests, without reader input: %s' retains all four older/newer and partly/wholly cases and both pre-rest and post-rest assertions, using controlled timers and any relevant performance clock.
The test waits for a meaningful timer/state boundary rather than an arbitrary physical260ms; production rest/cooldown values and history demand behavior are unchanged without retry, skip or ignore.
